description: This file defines the ClientNotAvailableException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a client is no longer reachable. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable.

classes.name: ClientNotAvailableException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating that a client is no longer reachable within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(GrainId clientId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message indicating no activation for the specified client ID.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message and an inner exception.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Obsolete constructor used for deserialization purposes.
